verdict.rationale: Sift's Workflows are an event-triggered rules engine that fires in real time during user events such as signups or orders. Nothing in the evidence shows recurring, time-based scheduling of jobs or workflows. A one-off or event-driven action is not a recurring schedule, so this adjacent feature earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Workflows enable you to make risk-based decisions in real time during key events.
